# Business Requirements Index

This folder contains business requirements derived from the current repository implementation, the documented public API behavior, and the module structure in the solution.

The UI consumer requirements below also reflect the current `aprraju/myvedicstar-ui` web and mobile applications. They describe the client behavior the APIs and business modules must support; they do not make UI-only calculations or persistence backend responsibilities.

## Modules

- [Panchang requirements](./panchang.md)

- [Traditions requirements](./traditions.md)
- [Localization requirements](./localization.md)
- [Authorization requirements](./authorization.md)
- [Settings requirements](./settings.md)
- [Email requirements](./email.md)
- [Caching requirements](./caching.md)

## Scope note
These requirements reflect the current API and UI implementation/documentation baseline. They are intentionally aligned to implemented and documented functionality rather than future roadmap assumptions. Guest access exceptions, feature flags, and future roadmap features must not be interpreted as generally anonymous or implemented API capabilities.
